title: Late-Booking Credit on Haul-Away Allowances — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
For a haul-away allowance on a Bridgewell replacement whose completion report is on file under a Homeowner Service Contract, and only for such an allowance, the payment is the lowest of the contracted disposal charge, the tier's haul-away allowance and the remaining aggregate benefit, with the late-booking credit added after that comparison, and a tier whose haul-away allowance is 0.00 still pays nothing for that type, so no haul-away allowance is owed or booked on it; every other allowance remains under the general allowance rule. For such an allowance, and only for such an allowance, it still pays toward removing and disposing of the equipment Bridgewell replaced and only on a replacement authorization, and its payment is the lowest of the contracted disposal charge, the tier's haul-away allowance and the remaining aggregate benefit with the late-booking credit added after that comparison, so that credit may carry the payment above the tier's haul-away allowance; every other allowance remains under the general allowance rule.

**The late-booking credit** follows the calendar days from the completion date to today:

| Days from the completion date to today | Late-booking credit |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | 0.10 for each day beyond 30 |
| more than 14 but no more than 30 | 0.50 for each full week beyond 14 |
| 14 or fewer | no credit |

The credit is rounded to the cent and added after the disposal charge has been compared with the haul-away allowance and the remaining aggregate benefit.

**Worked values.**

| Days elapsed | Calculation | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | none | 0.00 |
| 20 | 6 days beyond 14, no full week | 0.00 |
| 21 | 1 full week beyond 14 | 0.50 |
| 30 | 16 days beyond 14, 2 full weeks | 1.00 |
| 31 | 1 day beyond 30 | 0.10 |
| 45 | 15 days beyond 30 | 1.50 |

*Hypothetical:* the comparison gives 30.00 and the completion was 45 days ago: the haul-away payment is 30.00 plus 1.50, that is 31.50.
